hook: Kotlin 2.5 can export Swift directly, no SKIE needed.
hookText: Kotlin 2.5 can export Swift directly, no SKIE needed

beats.say: Kotlin 2.5's Swift Export beta, tested here in the 2.5.0-RC release, compiles shared modules straight into native Swift interfaces, instead of going through Objective-C headers.
Flow becomes a native AsyncSequence, so SwiftUI code can await updates and task cancellation propagates cleanly into Kotlin teardown.
The author tested the new export swift DSL, Dispatchers Default traps, and SwiftPM versus dynamic-framework collisions in Xcode builds.
